sources.entry: Desktop Control - GPU-accelerated CLI for AI agents to control any macOS app via screen, mouse, and keyboard.

summary.one_liner: DesktopCtl is a local macOS command-line tool that lets AI agents observe the screen and control apps through mouse, keyboard, and native menus.
summary.what_it_does: The tool is split into a background daemon (DesktopCtl.app / desktopctld) that handles screen perception, state, execution, and verification, and a stateless desktopctl CLI that sends actions and queries over local IPC. It provides OCR-based screen tokenization so agents can target elements by text or token, with coordinate fallback. It offers deterministic click, type, and wait primitives plus post-action verification. It can enumerate and invoke native macOS menu items through Accessibility. The README says processing runs fully locally and that screenshots are not sent to the cloud. Configuration and runtime data live in a Linux-style directory under DESKTOPCTL_HOME or XDG paths.
use_cases: let an AI agent click and type in macOS apps
automate keyboard and mouse actions on Mac
read on-screen text with OCR for agent grounding
invoke native macOS menu items from scripts
wait for UI state before the next action
build local desktop automation without cloud screenshots
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (installer from README; the URL was missing in the provided text)
notable: Selector-first automation using --text and --token with coordinate fallback
Runs locally; README states no screenshots are sent to the cloud
Works with any desktop AI agent or model, including non-vision models via OCR tokens
Stable JSON output contracts for agent integrations
Native macOS menu enumeration and invocation by #menu_* IDs
caveats: macOS only, and currently Apple Silicon only per the installation section
Requires Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions for DesktopCtl.app
App is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized; installer strips quarantine attribute
Status is active development; multi-platform support is roadmap only
